title: Inspect and extend: Convert untrusted response data into movie records
objective: Use the real implementation in `Sources/Core.swift` to demonstrate and safely improve response decoding/mapping and missing-field rejection.
problem: A mapper is a translator between an external shape and the app’s model. Follow the function that accepts a generic response and the test that rejects incomplete fields. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `Sources/Core.swift` and the related project files: Sources/Core.swift; Tests/MovieCoreTests.swift.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to response decoding/mapping and missing-field rejection.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: No API credentials or live server call are present in the sample app.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: A mapper is a translator between an external shape and the app’s model. Follow the function that accepts a generic response and the test that rejects incomplete fields.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `Sources/Core.swift`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
